interpretations: For each patient with a matching laboratory record, average `WBC` and average each laboratory record’s `HGB / HCT`; compare the patient’s average ratio with the unweighted mean of patient ratios.

For each patient with a matching laboratory record, average `WBC`, `HGB`, and `HCT` separately; divide average `HGB` by average `HCT` and compare that ratio with the unweighted mean of patient ratios.

For each patient with a matching laboratory record, average `WBC`; using only records where both `HGB` and `HCT` are present, divide average `HGB` by average `HCT` and compare that ratio with the unweighted mean of patient ratios.

In each interpretation, show ID, sex, average `WBC`, ratio, and ratio minus the mean for patients above the mean; sort by the gap descending with missing values last, return 10 rows, and do not round.
queries:
WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        AVG(l.WBC) AS average_wbc,
        AVG(l.HGB / NULLIF(l.HCT, 0)) AS average_ratio
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID
),
benchmark AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS mean_patient_ratio
    FROM patient_averages
)
SELECT
    pa.ID,
    pa.average_wbc,
    pa.average_ratio,
    b.mean_patient_ratio,
    CASE
        WHEN pa.average_ratio > b.mean_patient_ratio THEN 'above'
        WHEN pa.average_ratio < b.mean_patient_ratio THEN 'below'
        WHEN pa.average_ratio = b.mean_patient_ratio THEN 'equal'
    END AS ratio_comparison
FROM patient_averages AS pa
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b;

WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc,
        AVG(l.HGB) AS avg_hgb,
        AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_hct
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_wbc) AS avg_wbc,
    AVG(avg_hgb) AS avg_hgb,
    AVG(avg_hct) AS avg_hct,
    AVG(avg_hgb) / AVG(avg_hct) AS ratio_of_averages,
    AVG(avg_hgb / NULLIF(avg_hct, 0)) AS mean_of_patient_ratios
FROM patient_averages

WITH patient_stats AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc,
        AVG(CASE WHEN l.HGB IS NOT NULL AND l.HCT IS NOT NULL THEN l.HGB END) /
        NULLIF(AVG(CASE WHEN l.HGB IS NOT NULL AND l.HCT IS NOT NULL THEN l.HCT END), 0) AS patient_ratio
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID
)
SELECT
    ID,
    avg_wbc,
    patient_ratio,
    (SELECT AVG(patient_ratio) FROM patient_stats) AS mean_patient_ratio
FROM patient_stats

WITH patient_wbc AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc
    FROM Patient AS p
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(WBC) AS mean_wbc
    FROM Laboratory
)
SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    p.avg_wbc,
    p.avg_wbc / m.mean_wbc AS ratio,
    p.avg_wbc / m.mean_wbc - 1 AS ratio_minus_mean
FROM patient_wbc AS p
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m
WHERE p.avg_wbc > m.mean_wbc
ORDER BY ratio_minus_mean IS NULL, ratio_minus_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
